description: Lists files in a Figma project, optionally including metadata for branches of main files. DEPRECATED: Figma recommends the folders endpoint GET /v2/folders/:folder_id/files instead; existing integrations are unaffected.

inputSchema.description: Defines the parameters needed to retrieve a list of files from a specified Figma project.

branch_data.description: If true, includes metadata for branches of main files.
branch_data.title: Branch Data

project_id.description: Identifier of the Figma project, typically found in its URL.
project_id.title: Project Id

inputSchema.title: GetFilesInAProjectRequest

name: get_files_in_a_project

key.description: Unique opaque identifier for the Figma file.
key.title: Key

last_modified.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) of the last update to file content or metadata.
last_modified.title: Last Modified

name.description: The user-visible name of the Figma file.
name.title: Name

thumbnail_url.description: A temporary URL to a thumbnail image of the file's last saved version. This URL may change or expire.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

GetFilesInAProjectResponse.description: Represents the structure of the data returned, containing details about the project and its files.

data.description: Contains the project's details, including its name and a list of its associated files.
data.title: Data

GetFilesInAProjectResponse.title: GetFilesInAProjectResponse

files.description: `File` objects, each representing a file within the project.
files.title: Files

name.description: The name of the Figma project.
name.title: Name
